purpose: Release capability manifest for the Algenta Hugging Face kernel repositories (plan v3). Every release gate evaluates exactly this file.
status: APPROVED — ACL 1.1 + GA support scope merged in PR #1131 and rolled out to all 20 repos on 2026-09-22 (LEGAL-L1-003, LEGAL-L2-001, REPUBLISH-002); this manifest is the released capability set
torch_requirement: required — native per-torch variants; no torch-free universal native payload (the umbrella's torch-universal dir is a pure-Python kernel-depends dispatcher)

supported_configurations.floor: macOS 15.0 (minos; header-measured, real macOS-15 hardware run still open: HF-MACOS-001)

supported_configurations.stage_note: residentk staging tier 6144 (-D ALGENTA_STAGE_6144): decode admits models with max(d_model, h_q*d_head, d_ff) <= 6144 (Qwen3-0.6B, Qwen3-1.7B); larger models are refused with resident_dimension_too_large (REPUBLISH-004; GPU-SPACE-PARITY-001)

supported_configurations.note: PTX embedded per target; loader picks the newest built target <= device compute capability
supported_configurations.stage_note: residentk staging tier 6144 (-D ALGENTA_STAGE_6144): decode admits models with max(d_model, h_q*d_head, d_ff) <= 6144 (Qwen3-0.6B, Qwen3-1.7B); larger models are refused with resident_dimension_too_large (REPUBLISH-004; GPU-SPACE-PARITY-001)

candidates_not_published.reason: no AMD build+execution evidence on hardware (GPU-ROCM-001); stays a candidate

umbrella: thyn-ai/algenta (kernel-depends pinned by revision to each family's v1 head)
included_modules: per family: scripts/hf_kernel_filters.json (every executable module in exactly one family)

excluded_functions.column_rank.run_column_rank: takes a full JSON request string; reached through the column-ranking session, not a plain in-process call
excluded_functions.combinatorial.tsp_greedy: reads its distance argument as a square matrix; a non-square nested list is not expressible as a length rule
excluded_functions.contest_strategy.option_board: requires its per-entrant arrays to share one length; a mismatch is not expressible as a length rule
excluded_functions.dimensionality.power_iteration: reads its matrix argument as square; a non-square nested list is not expressible as a length rule
excluded_functions.dependency.dependency_depth: walks an adjacency list that must be acyclic and in range; not expressible as a length rule
excluded_functions.gbdt.gbdt_predict: walks a tree encoding that must be well-formed; a malformed tree is not expressible as a length rule
excluded_functions.svm_kernel.is_positive_semidefinite: reads its matrix argument as square; a non-square nested list is not expressible as a length rule
excluded_functions.svm_kernel.kernel_center: reads its matrix argument as square; a non-square nested list is not expressible as a length rule
excluded_functions.topology.filtration_values: requires a consistent distance/simplex structure; not expressible as a length rule
excluded_functions.topology.persistence_diagram_0: requires a consistent distance/simplex structure; not expressible as a length rule
excluded_functions.topology.vietoris_rips_edges: requires a square distance matrix; a non-square nested list is not expressible as a length rule
excluded_functions.trie.*: the trie functions take a Trie structure that a plain in-process call cannot build; use the SDK for tries
excluded_functions.constraint.magic_square_check: reads its grid argument as square; a non-square nested list is not expressible as a length rule
excluded_functions.compression.huffman.generate_codes: allocates from a frequency table whose size it trusts; an ill-formed table is not expressible as a length rule
excluded_functions.matrix_decomp.lu_decompose: reads its matrix argument as square; a non-square nested list is not expressible as a length rule
excluded_functions.matrix_decomp.trace: reads the diagonal of a square matrix; a non-square nested list is not expressible as a length rule
excluded_functions.datetime.now_epoch: needs the host interpreter (Python interop) — SIGSEGV in-process
excluded_functions.env.*: needs the host interpreter (Python interop) — SIGSEGV in-process

enforced_restrictions.restriction: at most ONE concurrent native worker per device
enforced_restrictions.mechanism: ABI §9: flock(LOCK_EX) on /dev/null taken inside algenta_runtime_execute in the compiled library; blocking; kernel-released on holder death; fail-closed (community_worker_slot_unavailable); the cap code reads no environment variable (abi.mojo has no getenv; gate scenario (e)); 17/19 family binaries import no getenv, bits-time and general-a import it transitively through the Mojo stdlib, inside the lock (general-a final artifact: hostile env 0.82 effective workers, 9/9 held)

enforced_restrictions.restriction: request validation at the native boundary
enforced_restrictions.mechanism: ABI §2–§5 (bounded C strings, nesting, count relations, excluded functions refused before dispatch)
sha256 of every native file verified against _native/manifest.json before dlopen (ABI 7.5)

license_only_obligations: Community-use thresholds (non-commercial, or < 50 employees AND < $5M revenue) — ACL §1/§2/§3(a)
no reverse-engineering of the engine binary — ACL §3(c)
device and seat counts ACROSS separate OS instances / machines — need identity; the licensed engine counts them, the no-login kernels cannot

accepted_deviations.deviation: Linux closure floor is glibc 2.35 (Ubuntu 22.04), not manylinux_2_28
macOS 15 CPU floor measured from headers (minos 15.0), no macOS-15 hardware run yet
